method: Construct for each of 103 tensor scaffolds 27 ordered triples A_i,B_j,C_k, retaining original role labels. Compare each field by its normalized textual coordinates and compare tensor role vocabularies. All matches lexical, not physical identity.
limits: Coordinates 1-1-1..3-3-3 are constructed from axis roles as proposed analytical projections, not historical verified field acts.
Identical role labels do not prove same quantities, invariants, equations or model.
Different labels can encode equivalent scientific mathematics and may need ontology/units/ontology mapping.
No scientific or formal tensor product, addition, contraction, or field theorem is inferred.
Do not collapse history or replace original source.
